location.basis: Published coordinates 23°14′15″N 70°40′39″E (Gadekar and Ajithprasad, Lithic Studies; English Wikipedia, Shikarpur, Gujarat). Not checked against imagery: plan-B works from published plans only.

sources.citation_or_service: Bhan, K. K. and P. Ajithprasad. Excavations at Shikarpur, Gujarat 2008-2009 (report on harappa.com).
sources.reason_not_used: The figures are a photograph of the fortification face, pottery, sealings and copper; there is no plan.

sources.citation_or_service: Bhan, K. K. and P. Ajithprasad. Excavations at Shikarpur 2007-2008: a coastal port and craft production center of the Indus Civilization in Kutch, India (harappa.com PDF). Fig. 1, 'Contour map of Shikarpur site' ('0.5 m contour plan of Shikarpur: Harappan site - 2008').
sources.reason_not_used: Contour plan of the mound with a local grid; no walls or other architecture are drawn.

sources.citation_or_service: Gadekar, C. and P. Ajithprasad. Shikarpur lithic assemblage: new questions regarding Rohri chert blade production. Journal of Lithic Studies. Figure 2, 'Plan of the Harappan site at Shikarpur showing features of the fortification wall with eastern entrance gate and plan of structures'.
sources.reason_not_used: The plan exists but the downloadable galley carries '[image]' placeholders instead of the figures, and the article page offers no separate figure files.

notes: The one published plan of Shikarpur's fortification and structures that we located (Figure 2 of Gadekar and Ajithprasad's lithic study, courtesy of the M. S. University of Baroda) is not reproduced in the open-access galley, which shows placeholders in place of its figures. The two excavation reports on harappa.com contain a contour plan of the mound and photographs only. The town is reported as not measurable from plans available to us; the galley's figure, or the excavators' own plan, would make it measurable.
